title: Fix 320
acceptance_criteria: A save refused because a criterion, requirement, case, observation, bug or native change reference holds a leak names the recovery, chough session shelve <session id>, beside removing the value. A committed session record whose case reference holds a token gives a leak finding naming chough session shelve <id>, and chough doctor --fix --redact leaves that ID unchanged with the finding skipped, so the session still reads, while it still redacts a leak on an ordinary line of the same record.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes, and the deltas are frozen at approval. No other lesson or principle constrains it.
